title: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-6

questions.question: Ustad Zakir Hussain plays which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Zakir Hussain is the most iconic contemporary master of the Tabla. A child prodigy and the son of Ustad Alla Rakha, he is credited with globalizing the sound of Indian percussion through his collaborations with artists like John McLaughlin and Mickey Hart.

questions.question: Ustad Bismillah Khan is associated with which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Bismillah Khan is the legendary maestro who popularized the Shehnai, an instrument traditionally played in temples and weddings, on the global concert stage. He was the first musician to be honored with the Bharat Ratna after performing at the Red Fort on India's first Independence Day.

questions.question: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is remembered for his mastery in playing _________.
questions.solution: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is the musician single-handedly responsible for bringing the Santoor into the fold of Indian Classical music. Originally a folk instrument from Kashmir, he modified it to produce the delicate nuances required for classical ragas.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities is a Sarod Maestro?
questions.solution: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan is a world-renowned Sarod maestro representing the sixth generation of the Bangash lineage. He is known for his unique 'fingernail' playing technique and for making the instrument more lyrical and expressive.

questions.question: Begum Akhtar is associated with which of the following fields?
questions.solution: Begum Akhtar, also known as 'Mallika-e-Ghazal' (Queen of Ghazals), was a legendary singer associated with Ghazal, Dadra, and Thumri. Her soulful voice and mastery over Urdu poetry made her an immortal figure in Hindustani semi-classical music.

questions.question: Santoor is associated with whom among the following?
questions.solution:
Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is synonymous with the Santoor.

Note: Pandit Jasraj and Bhimsen Joshi were legendary vocalists, while Hari Prasad Chaurasia is a maestro of the flute.

questions.question: Talat Aziz is primarily a ________ singer.
questions.solution: Talat Aziz is a prominent Ghazal singer from Hyderabad. Known for his smooth, silken voice, he was a disciple of Mehdi Hassan and gained immense popularity during the Ghazal boom of the 1980s.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities is/was NOT an Indian Ghazal singer?
questions.solution:
Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was a titan of Hindustani Classical Vocal music (Kirana Gharana), not a Ghazal singer.

Note: Begum Akhtar, Chitra Singh, and Jagjit Singh are all celebrated figures in the world of Ghazals.

questions.question: Who is credited with creating the popular Raga Miya Ki Malhar?
questions.solution: Tansen, one of the 'Navratnas' (nine jewels) in the court of Emperor Akbar, is credited with creating the powerful Raga Miya Ki Malhar. Legend says that his performance of this raga was so potent that it could summon rainfall.
